lore_facts: Advanced surgery on this page includes grafting or installing a 'protonic' prosthetic arm.
The setting has technology capable of reviving or awakening someone from a coma or coma-like state.
Aghnar's reproductive capacity is discussed as something that can be medically restored.
Honorata appears to be responsible for or involved in Oda's awakening.

plot_events: A disembodied or off-panel speaker insists on returning consciousness to a woman who will bear a son, while another speaker objects that he has children already.
A second speaker says the operation will take a long time, giving the man time to receive a new prosthetic arm.
A robot enthusiastically summarizes the apparent happy outcome: Honorata should wake from her coma, Oda should be revived, and Aghnar's reproductive capability is expected to be restored.
Another speaker corrects the robot, saying the event was not a happy ending and that they were partly responsible for a catastrophe.
The prosthetic-arm procedure is completed unusually quickly.
The man rushes to see whether his mother has succeeded in awakening Oda.
A woman identified as Oda appears revived, emerging from a chamber while onlookers react.
Someone warns Honorata to stop and not speak of failure or fatal words.
Aghnar and Oda recognize each other and say each other's names.
The page ends by noting that their names are the only words they manage to speak.

visual_summary: Inside a dark, futuristic medical or laboratory chamber, dialogue boxes continue an argument over reproduction and family. A small robot comments excitedly while a man is fitted with a mechanical arm by machines. In the central panel, a pale woman emerges upright from a pod or recovery chamber, draped in a translucent sheet, while several figures and robots turn toward her. The man with the new arm reacts with urgency, and the revived woman and the man each speak the other's name. A closing caption states that speaking each other's names is all they can manage.
